listing.name: Pokémon Colosseum — Colosseum_Recomp (grant-might)
listing.summary: Upstream documents a build-and-play route, naming-screen text and widescreen fixes and intro-overlay behavior. It does not claim a complete playthrough. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own Pokémon Colosseum disc image. Shipped build requires GC6E01. ISO is normal; picker also lists WBFS/RVZ, whose exact acceptance needs readback. Extracted files and 168 REL overlays are used; the generated module is not shipped.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: README describes colosseum-launcher-2.zip, containing the launcher, runner, app-local MSVC libraries and two digest-pinned offline component archives. Extracts the owned disc, generates C and compiles a DOL-hash-cached DLL locally on first run; no first-run network access.

warnings: Upstream documents a build-and-play route, naming-screen text and widescreen fixes and intro-overlay behavior. It does not claim a complete playthrough.
